sources.entry: virtualenv - A tool to create isolated Python environments.

summary.one_liner: virtualenv is a tool for creating isolated Python virtual environments.
summary.what_it_does: The README is very short and only states that virtualenv is a tool for creating isolated virtual Python environments. It links out to installation docs, documentation, changelog, issue tracker, PyPI, and GitHub pages, but the README itself does not describe specific features, commands, or usage. It also includes a Code of Conduct note saying contributors should follow the PSF Code of Conduct. Details beyond the one-line purpose are not given in the README text provided.
use_cases: manage python package versions per project
notable: Listed in vinta/awesome-python under Environment Management
Maintained under the pypa (Python Packaging Authority) GitHub organization
Project links to PyPI and external documentation
caveats: README is very short; installation and usage details are only available via linked external docs
License not stated in the README provided
